edition_confirmation: User explicitly confirmed all eight categories apply to ShellHacks 2026; accepted without rechecking mixed labels.
inventory_scope: Eight confirmed categories; additional organizer/sponsor challenges remain unknown. This is not an exhaustive inventory.
common_deliverable_gap: The eight cards do not establish the current ShellHacks submission URL, exact cutoff, form fields, video/demo duration or source-code requirements.
common_eligibility_gate: Participant eligibility, event participation, build/reuse compliance, actual sponsor use and category opt-in must be satisfied. Current event-specific submission and reuse details remain pending.
marketing_boundary: Tiger Data claims about instant queries, lag-free charts and 90%+ compression, and other sponsors’ speed, scalability, naturalness and free-access claims, are not guarantees or measured results for a proposed prototype.

challenges.title: Best Use of ElevenLabs
challenges.required: Integrate ElevenLabs audio into the project. The brief requests an autonomous audio experience but does not define a minimum architecture.
challenges.judging: Best use; no scored rubric in the card. Voice naturalness and expressiveness describe capabilities, not published scoring weights.
challenges.examples: AI companions, narrated stories and voice-enabled applications are suggestions. A specific example is not required.
challenges.deliverables: A hack using ElevenLabs audio; no separate artifact, video length or API-log format stated.
challenges.eligibility: No card-specific participant restriction stated. Credit-code redemption requires login; credit eligibility is not prize eligibility.
challenges.unresolved: Whether simple TTS suffices for the autonomous wording; access/quota/credits; submission process and category stacking.
challenges.recommended_proof: A live conversational audio loop and visible action/state trace; a cached recording must be labeled.
challenges.secondary_status: Technical compatibility only; multiple-entry and simultaneous-award eligibility unverified

challenges.title: Best Use of Gemini API
challenges.required: Build an AI application using the Gemini API. Using Gemini only to help write code does not demonstrate product integration.
challenges.judging: Best use; no weighted rubric in the card. The invitation to impress is not a measurable threshold.
challenges.examples: Advice chatbots, paper summaries and creative generation are optional examples.
challenges.deliverables: An application using the API; no distinct video/repository requirements in this card.
challenges.eligibility: No card-specific restriction stated; account/model access must be checked separately.
challenges.prize: MLH swag kits; quantities and contents unspecified.
challenges.unresolved: Eligible models/endpoints if ambiguous, quotas, any specific opt-in/evidence and category stacking.
challenges.recommended_proof: Actual API-derived output changes the user task; show validated output and a failure/abstention case.
challenges.secondary_status: Technical compatibility only; multiple-entry and simultaneous-award eligibility unverified

challenges.title: Best Use of Solana
challenges.required: Build a project using Solana. A meaningful on-chain operation is the clearest way to show this; a logo or wallet login alone is weak integration.
challenges.judging: Innovation is encouraged; no formal weights or mandatory throughput figure.
challenges.examples: Frequent-transaction games, trading/lending/DEX, identity, supply-chain and payment prototypes are suggestions.
challenges.deliverables: A Solana-based prototype; network choice, program source and explorer evidence requirements are not specified.
challenges.eligibility: No card-specific restriction stated. Devnet acceptance and any network/token conditions remain unverified.
challenges.prize: Ledger Nano S Plus; text describes prizes for each team member.
challenges.unresolved: Devnet/localnet acceptance, whether a custom program is required, RPC/faucet access, entry/award limits.
challenges.recommended_proof: Signed state transition, rejected invalid transition and explorer evidence on an accepted network; no real funds needed for planning.
challenges.secondary_status: Technical compatibility only; multiple-entry and simultaneous-award eligibility unverified

challenges.title: Best Use of Tiger Data
challenges.required: Use Tiger Data to power the project. Select its actual platform/service, rather than assume generic PostgreSQL counts.
challenges.judging: The card explicitly emphasizes innovative, impactful and performance-driven use. No weights are supplied.
challenges.examples: IoT monitoring, AI analytics and financial prediction are examples. Continuous aggregates and combined relational/time-series data are capabilities, not a requirement to use every feature.
challenges.deliverables: Demonstrate how Tiger Data powers the project; no fixed benchmark, compression target or submission format stated.
challenges.eligibility: No card-specific restriction stated. Service/extension qualification and actual account entitlements need confirmation.
challenges.unresolved: Cloud access/credits and required product variant; event rubric interaction; benchmark conditions; entry/award limits.
challenges.recommended_proof: Show a sponsor-dependent time-series operation, a correctness check and a reproducible measured comparison.
challenges.secondary_status: Technical compatibility only; multiple-entry and simultaneous-award eligibility unverified

challenges.title: Best Use of DigitalOcean
challenges.required: Build using DigitalOcean infrastructure or services. A deployed functional service gives direct evidence of use.
challenges.judging: Best use; no card-specific scored rubric or scaling threshold.
challenges.examples: Droplets, Managed Databases, App Platform and Gradient AI/GPU/inference are alternatives, not an all-services checklist.
challenges.deliverables: A project using its cloud services; no mandatory public uptime, architecture or video format stated.
challenges.eligibility: Account access required; the card directs teams to an MLH Coach for credits, which are not guaranteed by the brief.
challenges.prize: Retro wireless mouse; text describes prizes for each teammate.
challenges.unresolved: Credit availability, billing/region limits, required evidence, runtime/deployment constraints, entry/award limits.
challenges.recommended_proof: A working hosted backend and observable deployment/operations evidence; basic hosting alone may offer limited distinction.
challenges.secondary_status: Technical compatibility only; multiple-entry and simultaneous-award eligibility unverified

challenges.title: Best Use of Snowflake API
challenges.required: Integrate a Snowflake API into the application. The card does not require a particular endpoint or a count of models.
challenges.judging: Best use; no scored rubric in the card. Speed-of-development claims are promotional.
challenges.examples: Custom applications, RAG chatbots and embedded AI are optional examples. Calling many models is not required.
challenges.deliverables: An API-powered project; no mandatory dataset size, model count or deliverable format stated.
challenges.eligibility: The card advertises a special student 120-day trial; account/trial eligibility and enabled models are separate access checks.
challenges.unresolved: Trial activation, role permissions, model/region access, whether selected endpoint qualifies, submission/stacking.
challenges.recommended_proof: Use an actual Snowflake endpoint for a necessary project function; tie the response to grounded evidence and preserve source identifiers.
challenges.secondary_status: Technical compatibility only; multiple-entry and simultaneous-award eligibility unverified

challenges.title: Best Use of MongoDB Atlas
challenges.required: Build a hack using MongoDB Atlas. A local-only MongoDB database is not evidence of Atlas use.
challenges.judging: Best use; no distinct weighted rubric in the card.
challenges.examples: No required domain or database feature. Courses, student credits and free-tier access are offers, not mandatory project features.
challenges.deliverables: A hack using Atlas; no mandated schema, vector search, minimum scale or artifact format stated.
challenges.eligibility: No prize-specific restriction stated. Student credit eligibility differs from standard account/free-tier access.
challenges.prize: M5Stack IoT Kit; text describes one for each group member.
challenges.unresolved: Current tier/feature availability, credits, network access, submission evidence and entry/award limits.
challenges.recommended_proof: Atlas performs a meaningful persistence, query or consistency function; do not add a duplicate database.
challenges.secondary_status: Technical compatibility only; multiple-entry and simultaneous-award eligibility unverified
